about: The code packages theOS runs on the Mac beside its own code (avendb/crates/avendb-device/src/lean.rs), each file pinned by the BLAKE3 hash of its bytes, and by the SHA-256 its publisher gives where it gives one. Maia City keeps them as file entries tagged `package:<id>` and `blake3:<hash>` (scripts/propose-code.mjs proposes them); the avenDB app's Code page (src/lib/avendb/Code.svelte) shows them. A device brings a file only from avenDB, and never unpacks or runs a copy whose bytes don't hash to its pins.

packages.label: Lean
packages.note: The Lean release avendb/spec/lean-toolchain pins, for Apple silicon Macs: theOS keeps lean, its libraries and the Init library's .olean files out of it (1,964 of its 18,534 files) and runs them only in Lean's own sandbox.
